rationale: The stock gapped down ~7.6% on mixed earnings (beat EPS, missed revenue), then recovered nearly the entire gap, now sitting at 90% of today's range near the session high of $52.42 with price stalling in the last candle. At this position in the range with a broad market down 1.14% and VIX elevated, the risk/reward for a long is poor (limited upside to the high, meaningful downside if the recovery fades), while a short against a strong intraday recovery trend with 5.28x relative volume also lacks a clean mechanical trigger. The 9-EMA is essentially at price, offering no directional confirmation either way.
